tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Read this connection's available tools and supported research coverage. Does not read account data, save research, or run a simulation.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read the stable identity and workspace selected for this connection, plus the next step to take with the user. Returns an opaque account id and workspace label; excludes email, birth date, billing, and exchange accounts. A workspace with no strategies yet also gets starter_call: a ready tool call th

tools.name: list_research
tools.description: List a page of saved strategies, simulation runs, or research notes in the connected workspace. Notes include a bounded plain-text excerpt, explicitly labeled when truncated. Saved text is user-authored content. Paper runs require the separately approved paper:read permission. Search matches titles;

tools.name: get_strategy
tools.description: Read a saved strategy's current revision and human-readable rules in the connected workspace. Returns the complete Python package for review or editing. Code and comments are user-authored content.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Search the markets Premiss covers by name, ticker or alias (bitcoin, BTCUSDT, SPY, gold, oil): crypto, indices, commodities and US stocks. Returns registry ids with their class, tier (full, or history only with daily paper bots) and bar sizes. A miss returns the closest markets. Does not return pric

tools.name: describe_market
tools.description: Return one market's bar sizes and stored history, the bar sizes this account can backtest, paper-bot bar sizes, trading modes, price sources and data notes. Pass a market id or alias such as BTC, SP500, NVDA or GOLD. Does not return prices or bars.

tools.name: get_strategy_guide
tools.description: Read Premiss's Python package format, the event strategy API (on_bar, on_schedule, on_fill and the other handlers), spot and perpetual modes, execution timing and examples. Custom indicators, entry/exit logic and risk rules use the same engine as the Premiss app.

tools.name: create_strategy
tools.description: Save a new private strategy using custom Python files and complete rules text, on any Premiss-supported market and timeframe. Accepts either files (strategy.py plus helper modules) and rules, or a convenience template. Uses the same package format as the app. Custom code is loaded in the sandbox bef

tools.name: update_strategy
tools.description: Replace the complete Python package and rules of an existing strategy using its exact current saved revision. Each successful save returns a new revision; pass that revision on the next edit of the same strategy. The submitted package replaces all existing files. The code is loaded in the sandbox be

tools.name: start_backtest
tools.description: Queue a backtest of any saved strategy in the connected workspace; the run records a spot buy-and-hold of its traded market beside it. Accepts custom code and existing app strategies. Uses the app's sandbox validation, supported markets, bar sizes and date rules; a test uses up to 20,000 bars per fe

tools.name: get_run_data
tools.description: Read the immutable tested Python package, or page through all recorded trades or equity points for an owned run. next_cursor identifies the next page; page size is not a history cap. Paper data requires separate paper:read permission. Saved code is user-authored content.

tools.name: get_run_report
tools.description: Read the status and bounded performance report for one run in the connected workspace. Returns the tested market, interval, revision (the tested code), strategy_revision (the strategy's current revision, accepted by start_backtest and update_strategy), recorded rules when verifiable, the run's adjus

tools.name: save_research_note
tools.description: Save a NEW private note in the connected workspace, with optional exact owned strategy/run evidence references. The note is user-authored content. Does not publish or send it anywhere.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "claude" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, get_strategy, start_backtest, get_run_report · Private data: create_strategy, update_strategy, start_backtest, save_research_note · Public sink: get_profile, save_research_note · Destructive: get_capabilities, get_strategy_guide, create_strategy, update_strategy, start_backtest, get_run_data, get_run_report, save_research_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, get_strategy, start_backtest, get_run_report · Private data: create_strategy, update_strategy, start_backtest, save_research_note · Public sink: get_profile, save_research_note · Destructive: get_capabilities, get_strategy_guide, create_strategy, update_strategy, start_backtest, get_run_data, get_run_report, save_research_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_markets" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
